title: Ink Water
body:
**This simple texture pack turns your water into ink.**

---

I just made this because I realised the ink from the Bendy and the Crafting Machine mod didn't have the dripping particles.

## Extra stuff.
I think I've changed all of the water in the game but I may have missed some things.

Bubbles are not being changed.

_(Made for the Bendy and the Crafting Machine mod)_
